note: The Pocket Invoice brand, for the UX pathway's high-fidelity files. Read by tools/ux_hifi.mjs with pocket-invoice-tokens.json: colours, type sizes, weights, spacing, radii, borders and the control size come only from the token file; this file adds the words, the wordmark and the layout widths. Pocket Invoice is invented for practice.
name: Pocket Invoice
tagline: Invoices for freelancers, on a phone or a computer.

wordmark.about: A rounded square in color.action.primary with a bold P in color.text.inverse, then the name in bold color.text.default.

voice: Plain words that say what happens next: Create workspace, Send invoice.
Every error names the fix: Enter a workspace name, not Invalid input.
Keep what the user typed after every error and every way back.
rules: Colours, type sizes, weights, spacing, radii and borders come only from the token file.
Text meets 4.5:1 contrast, large text 3:1; control boundaries meet 3:1 (WCAG 2.2, 1.4.3 and 1.4.11).
Buttons and inputs are at least size.control (48 px) tall, above the 24 px minimum target in WCAG 2.2 (2.5.8).
Never colour alone: an error also has a bar, the word Error and a message.
